coverage_summary: Reviewed all six submitted trajectories. The pretraining branches are mostly evidence-aligned, with one unsupported merge of the two protein corpora. The reconstruction omits the documented SFT, benchmark-evaluation, router-audit, and OmniGene-4 v3 contexts.

findings.detail: The trajectory collapses Protein 1 and Protein 2 into one corpus and one tokenizer/chunking path. The paper lists two separate protein sources and only specifies that the protein BPE was trained on protein_uni_16.txt; it does not establish identical tokenization, merging, ordering, or chunking for protein_lucaone_15g.txt.

evidence.quote: Protein BPE ( <PRO_*> )  | 8,000   | BPE trained on 16GB protein_uni_16.txt |

findings.required_change: Preserve separate source branches through tokenization/chunking, or represent their merge as an explicitly unresolved boundary without asserting a shared path.

findings.detail: The documented fine-tuning input pipeline is absent, including conversion to {instruction, input, output} triples, section-marker splitting, thought-block removal, the v3 remote-homology augmentation branch, and the wrapped prompt template.

evidence.quote: We construct OmniGene-SFT-v1 , a 199,576-row instruction dataset unified in {instruction, input, output} triple form
Messages-format sources are converted to the triple form by splitting on section markers and stripping any <THOUGHT> blocks from outputs.
For the v3 remote-homology ablation, we add 20,000 additional rows sampled from dnagpt/biopaws::protein_p

findings.required_change: Add a fine_tuning trajectory for Bio-SFT v2/v3 covering the documented triple conversion, thought-block removal, remote-pair augmentation, wrapping, and the stated 1,024-token input cap; leave undisclosed label masking and tokenizer details unresolved.

findings.detail: The Cell and Mol input branches are omitted from the reconstruction despite documented source-specific preprocessing and task templates.

evidence.quote: The Cell pool (30K rows) is constructed from PanglaoDB-style [14] marker panels covering ≈ 40 human cell types across 6 task templates
The Mol pool (also 30K rows) is built from nine MoleculeNet [57] datasets (21,746 unique canonical SMILES) with RDKit-derived physico-chemical descriptors across 6 task templates.

findings.required_change: Add the documented Cell and Mol source/preprocessing branches, retaining unknown serialization details as opaque boundaries.

findings.detail: The evaluation input flows are absent. The paper documents distinct Standard-homology, Remote-homology, and BixBench protocols, including prompt reuse, output parsing, and the BixBench result-field cap.

evidence.quote: Standard homology : 30% random sample of dnagpt/biopaws::protein_pair_short (6,000 pairs, balanced labels, seed 42). The prompt matches the SFT training prompt; the parser accepts Homologous / Non-Homologous in the first 40 characters of output (caseinsensitive)
Remote homology : 2,000 pairs (1,000 per label) sampled with seed 42
BixBench Knowledge [15]: all True / False questions ( ≈ 200). Input truncated to 500 characters of the result field.

findings.required_change: Add an evaluation-phase trajectory for all three benchmark task inputs and preserve the documented parser and 500-character preprocessing boundary as opaque where implementation details are undisclosed.

findings.detail: The router-audit input and observation pipeline is absent, including the eight task pools, 50-sample branches, 384-token cap, three checkpoint branches, forward hooks, routing-event counts, and token-ID capture for layers 11–13.

evidence.quote: Each hook captures the top_k_index tensor, shape [ B · S, k ], from the router output and accumulates a count of (layer, expert) activations.
We repeat for 8 task pools with 50 samples each ( ≈ 400 samples total), capping sequences at 384 tokens.
We run the pipeline on three checkpoints: baseline (Gemma-4-Instruct with extended vocab and mean-initialized new embeddings, no LoRA), CPT-only, and v3.
For the token-level analysis (§3.3.1) we additionally record, for every routing event at layers 11, 12, 13, the input token ID that triggered it

findings.required_change: Add a router-audit evaluation trajectory with separate checkpoint/task-pool branches and an opaque hook-capture boundary; retain the documented cap and token/layer correspondence without inventing padding or alignment mechanics.

findings.detail: The Atlas model variant OmniGene-4 v3 is not covered by any model_variant or trajectory, although it is a distinct documented training configuration with an added remote-homology SFT stage and is used in evaluation and router analysis.

evidence.quote: Bio-SFT v3 (remote-augmented) uses the lower rate 2 × 10 -5 for 1 epoch
We run the pipeline on three checkpoints: baseline ..., CPT-only, and v3.

findings.required_change: Cover OmniGene-4 v3 with fine_tuning and evaluation trajectories, or explicitly document why the Atlas variant is excluded.
